verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a developer framework like Mastra, so the axis applies. The pack only documents observability features the developer turns on for their own agents (tracing, tracking latency, cost, and tool usage). Nothing shows a way to opt out of vendor telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
